messages:
tessa_marketing: Finalizing logistics for Jun 7 webinar — quick runbook check. Need signoff on reg page fields, Zoom recording config, and post-event routing.

liam_ops: Zoom: cloud record (host), cloud transcript ON, save chat ON, separate audio tracks for panelists. Local backup optional for host.

hana_content: Reg page: email + name required, company & title optional, add a short free-text 'what problem are you solving with LLMs?' checkbox for interest. Also add GDPR consent checkbox.

rico_media: After event I'll pull MP4 + SRT, run our clipper to produce 3x 60s highlights. Need separate audio tracks to isolate speaker clips.

tessa_marketing: Jules - confirm HubSpot flow: tag = webinar_jun7, add property last_webinar=jun7, create task for AE if "interested_in_pilot" selected.

jules_growth: Done. Workflow in HubSpot: form -> contact -> add tag webinar_jun7 -> add to list "webinar_follows" -> send webhook to zapier for recording access if attendee=yes.

syncbot: [automation] Zoom folder watcher active. Will post when files land in /zoom/redwood/jun7.

tessa_marketing: Small ask: capture chat Qs into a doc. Hana, can you own Q&A extraction?

hana_content: Yep I'll pull chat + transcript and make a Q&A doc for the follow-up email.

tessa_marketing: Great. Final checklist: reg page fields -> hana ✅, zoom config -> liam ✅, hubspot flow -> jules ✅, media pipeline -> rico ✅. Locking thread. Update here if anything changes. :rocket:
